title: Week 1: Listening and interaction: Greetings and respectful register
objectives: Apply and explain listening and interaction: greetings and respectful register using the specified independent and transfer tasks.
entry_evidence: Notice who is speaking and to whom.

steps.instruction:
Hola greets; buenos días greets in the morning. Tú is informal singular; usted is a respectful singular form. Practices vary by community; use the interlocutor's preference.
Four 15-minute language sessions are additional distributed practice. Session A: listen to the adult's first turn, ask for repetition if needed, and respond. Session B: respond to the follow-up without seeing it in advance. Then create one new fictional exchange using the week's construction. Session C: read the script, write a new two-turn exchange with different fictional details, and explain one relevant form or meaning choice. Session D: use the checked new exchange in contingent conversation, introducing a changed detail to repair. An adult models and checks the new exchange before it is practiced. Hearing, reading, copying and speaking are different evidence routes. No accent preference or speed requirement is imposed.
Entry check: ask the learner to demonstrate the stated prerequisite with a fresh example. If missing, teach that skill first; do not treat age or an earlier week number as evidence of readiness.

title: Week 27: Listening and interaction: Useful irregular past forms
objectives: Apply and explain listening and interaction: useful irregular past forms using the specified independent and transfer tasks.

steps.instruction:
Ir and ser share preterite forms fui,fuiste,fue,fuimos,fuisteis,fueron. Context distinguishes went from was/were; an isolated form may be ambiguous.
Four 15-minute language sessions are additional distributed practice. Session A: listen to the adult's first turn, ask for repetition if needed, and respond. Session B: respond to the follow-up without seeing it in advance. Then create one new fictional exchange using the week's construction. Session D: use the checked new exchange in contingent conversation, introducing a changed detail to repair. An adult models and checks the new exchange before it is practiced. Hearing, reading, copying and speaking are different evidence routes. No accent preference or speed requirement is imposed.
